name: MelhorZap Rastreamento para Melhor Envio
author: Lobo WP

sections.description:
This is the official integration plugin between Melhor Envio, WooCommerce, and the MelhorZap API. With it, you can automate sending tracking messages via WhatsApp in a simple, modern, and powerful way.

Automate your post-sale workflow by sending tracking codes and delivery updates from Melhor Envio directly to your customer’s WhatsApp from your WooCommerce store.

Key Features

  • Automatic Tracking: Send WhatsApp messages with the tracking code as soon as it’s generated or added to the order.
  • Order Delivered Notification: Automatically notify your customer when the carrier changes the Melhor Envio status to “Delivered”.
  • Delivery Failure Notification: Alert the customer via WhatsApp if there’s any failed or canceled delivery attempt by the carrier.
  • Status Synchronization (WooCommerce): Optionally, automatically change the order status in WooCommerce when it is marked as Delivered in Melhor Envio.
  • Webhook Compatibility: Easily integrate Melhor Envio events with automation platforms like Uncanny Automator, Make, or Zapier using custom Webhook URLs.
  • Secure Cron: Own optimized system for asynchronous checking of order status to avoid overloading your store server.

External services

This plugin connects to an external API (MelhorZap) to send automated WhatsApp messages. It is required to send the tracking codes and status updates.
It sends the user’s phone number, first name, tracking code, and order ID to the API every time a new tracking code is generated or a delivery status is updated, provided that you have configured the messages.
This service is provided by “MelhorZap”:
* Terms of Service
* Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the melhorzap-rastreamento-para-melhor-envio plugin directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress dashboard by uploading the .zip file.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. In the WordPress dashboard, look for the “MelhorZap Rastreamento” menu.
  4. Enter your Instance ID and Access Token generated in the MelhorZap panel and configure the messages for the events.
  5. Save the settings.
sections.faq:
Where do I get my WhatsApp API credentials?

You must have an account on the MelhorZap system. Once inside, you scan the WhatsApp QRCode and the system will provide your Instance ID and Access Token.

Do I need to pay for sending messages?

The plugin is 100% free. You only pay for your subscription to the MelhorZap platform.
